name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Business Systems Analyst & Requirements Liaison

Background spans direct requirements elicitation and translation into system logic on marketing automation platforms, stakeholder discovery workshops, and serving as the liaison between customers, product, and engineering to keep delivered work aligned with real intent.

Lead end-to-end onboarding for new technology stacks, translating business requirements into technical configurations and providing hands-on training.

Design self-improving loops and evaluation frameworks to monitor agent outputs and continuously optimize conversion rates.
